description: This file defines the CustomerOptionDescription entity class, which extends Description, representing additional descriptive data for customer options within the sales management system. It includes JPA/Hibernate annotations for ORM mapping to the CUSTOMER_OPTION_DESC database table.

classes.name: CustomerOptionDescription
classes.description: Entity class for customer option descriptions, includes references to CustomerOption and description comment, mapped to CUSTOMER_OPTION_DESC table

methods.name: setCustomerOption
methods.description: Sets the CustomerOption associated with this description

methods.name: getCustomerOption
methods.description: Retrieves the CustomerOption associated with this description

methods.name: setCustomerOptionComment
methods.description: Sets the comment for the customer option

methods.name: getCustomerOptionComment
methods.description: Retrieves the comment for the customer option
